text: Commercial Bank of Dubai's 2025 annual report lists the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD) as a 20 percent shareholder, and its related-party note states that ICD is wholly owned by the Government of Dubai; Forbes Middle East calls ICD the bank's largest shareholder with a 20% stake.
short: The Government of Dubai's Investment Corporation of Dubai holds 20% of Commercial Bank of Dubai.

source.name: Commercial Bank of Dubai: Annual Report 2025 (shareholder structure)
source.quote: Investment Corporation of Dubai - 20% Al Futtaim Private Company LLC - 17.46% Orient Insurance PJSC - 8.84%
source.note: Major-shareholder breakdown on physical page 18 of the PDF ('CBD at a Glance'), pypdf extraction; the same page lists Abdul Wahed Al Rostamani (AWR) Group 7.68% and Ghobash Trading & Investment 6.37%. Note 33 (Related party transactions, physical page 72) states: 'the Investment Corporation of Dubai ("ICD") owns 20% share capital of the Group. ICD is a wholly-owned entity by the Government of Dubai (the "Government").'

additionalSources.name: Forbes Middle East: 30 Most Valuable Banks 2025, entry '20. Commercial Bank of Dubai (CBD)'
additionalSources.quote: The Investment Corporation of Dubai is the bank's largest shareholder, owning a 20% stake, as of February 19, 2025
